requirements.statement: For each image button (<input type="image">) that has a text alternative, outside the particular cases, the alternative is relevant.

citations.quote: ayant une alternative textuelle, cette alternative est-elle pertinente (hors cas particuliers) ?
vérifier que l’alternative textuelle est pertinente

routes.statement: Each source present is relevant: the alt attribute, the title attribute, the aria-label attribute and the passage of text linked by aria-labelledby.

citations.quote: S’il est présent, le contenu de l’attribut `alt` est pertinent
S’il est présent, le contenu de l’attribut `title` est pertinent
S’il est présent, le contenu de l’attribut WAI-ARIA `aria-label` est pertinent
S’il est présent, le passage de texte associé via l’attribut WAI-ARIA `aria-labelledby` est pertinent
L’intitulé d’un bouton doit décrire l’action qui résulte de son activation

exceptions.statement: An image used as a CAPTCHA or as an image-test: criterion 1.3 is not applicable to it; criterion 1.4 treats it.

citations.quote: lorsque l’image est utilisée comme CAPTCHA ou comme image-test
le cas des CAPTCHA et des images-test est traité de manière spécifique par le critère 1.4.

rationale.text: Relevance is judgment: code cannot decide whether a text tells what an image button does. Whether an image button is a CAPTCHA or an image-test is judgment too. So no check can fault an alternative as surely irrelevant on an element surely in scope, nor pass a page, and the entry stays at none. The wording lists the sources and asks that each one present be relevant ("S’il est présent"), not only the one the accessible-name order selects; the entry models this as one requirement with one route that names every source. The particular case of criterion 1.3 is an exception: CAPTCHA and image-test images, which criterion 1.4 treats. Unlike the other tests of the criterion, the wording of 1.3.3 does not say "porteuse d’information": it covers every image button with a text alternative. Finding those buttons is mechanical, but relevance is not: the glossary of a button says its label must describe the action its activation causes, which code cannot judge. The glossary notes on links and buttons are not exceptions here: they speak of an image inside a link or a <button> element, and an image button is an <input>. No axe rule is tagged and no custom check is registered. Applicability is judgment, because whether every image button on the page is a CAPTCHA or an image-test, which would leave the test not applicable, is judgment. Needs is empty: the methodology asks for no assistive technology. The glossary says that where the name computation is only partly supported, the value assistive technologies really render is the alternative; that matters for which text is judged, not for whether the test can be examined, and at none nothing is concluded.

citations.quote: Image qui véhicule une information nécessaire à la compréhension du contenu auquel elle est associée.
Pour une image porteuse d’information, l’alternative textuelle apporte l’information nécessaire à la compréhension du contenu qu’elle véhicule
c’est la valeur réellement restituée par les technologies d’assistance utilisées dans l’environnement de test (ou « base de référence ») qu’il faudra considérer comme alternative textuelle
